settings.heading: Returns & Exchange
settings.intro: We want you to love your gear. If something isn't right, here's how we'll make it right.

settings.title: 1. Request
settings.text: Contact us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and reason.

settings.title: 2. We Review
settings.text: Our team confirms eligibility and shares simple return instructions.

settings.title: 3. Exchange
settings.text: Once received and inspected, we process your exchange or store credit.

settings.heading: 7-day easy exchange
settings.text:
You may request an exchange within 7 days of delivery, provided the item is unused, in its original packaging, and with all tags and accessories included.

Damaged or wrong items. If you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos and we'll make it right at no extra cost.

Non-returnable items. For hygiene and safety, certain items (e.g. used supports, opened supplements, custom orders) cannot be returned unless faulty.

To start a return or exchange, email [support@subhanfitness.pk] or WhatsApp [+92 300 1234567] with your order number.
